canon: Nell introduced herself to Kell as Nell Quickfingers, and Kell wrote the name down.
Moll muttered in dock cant; Nell caught the words “bluebottle” and “good coat.”
Moll refused to say what was in her closed fist and became more watchful of Nell.
Cob said he had found the boots and insisted they were his; the left boot crackled when he stamped.
Nell tried to reach into Cob’s left boot, but Cob caught her fingers and pulled away, clutching the boot to his chest.
Moll dropped from the wall and moved between Nell and Cob; Cob backed toward the water butt.
